Attached: 1 video

Sterling Koch started at Sidero Labs on the first day of KubeCon EU, at our booth. 

The Talos community showed up in such numbers that the booth's main job became crowd control.  

In his TalosCon talk, Sterling explains what that taught him about this community and why everything we build is for it and because of it. 

Full talk: https://youtu.be/PepTXCf5FYo?si=djWzM2xWu9Qfr-hO 

#TalosLinux #KubeCon #Kubernetes #CloudNative #TalosCon
